key_reasoning.reason: Single self-contained component — ConfluenceDatasourceLoader.process_pages modified to isolate per-page HTTPError(404) and a new get_load_stats() method added, both within the same class, no layer boundary crossed.

Reuses the file's existing pattern of inspecting requests.exceptions.HTTPError.response.status_code (already used by _is_transient_error for 502/503/504) and applies it to a new case (404 skip, 403+ still propagates); not a literal copy-paste but a well-established pattern with no performance or security implications.
